verdict.rationale: Conductor documents 'routines' that run agents on a schedule or via a GitHub Action, which covers CI use. A programmatic API lets you create cloud workspaces, send prompts to the agent and read its replies, and a hosted MCP server offers automation hooks outside the Mac GUI. Cloud sandboxes also keep agents working after the laptop is closed. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the GitHub Action/routines setup, a headless CLI mode for local (non-cloud) workspaces, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404s), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI use.
